review.tagline: PyTorch library for object detection and segmentation research
review.summary: Detectron2 is Facebook AI Research's PyTorch library for object detection and segmentation, successor to Detectron and maskrcnn-benchmark. It covers panoptic segmentation, DensePose, Cascade R-CNN, rotated boxes, PointRend, DeepLab, ViTDet and MViTv2, and ships a Model Zoo of baselines. Models can be exported to TorchScript or Caffe2.
review.audience: Computer vision researchers training detection and segmentation models
strengths: Wide algorithm coverage: panoptic segmentation, DensePose, PointRend, ViTDet, MViTv2, rotated boxes
Model Zoo with downloadable baselines and trained weights
Export to TorchScript or Caffe2 for deployment
Modular design for building research projects on top; Apache-2.0
weaknesses: Last tagged release is 2021-11-15, though commits continue
Not a model server; no inference API or UI included
Install steps live in external docs, not the README
Hardware requirements are not stated in the README
needs: Models: Mask R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, Panoptic segmentation, DensePose, PointRend
